graph.loadErrorDescription: The repository history could not be read. Try again.
graph.emptyDescription: Commit history will appear here when this repository has committed work.
graph.title: Commit graph
graph.refreshTitle: Reload the graph from current branches, remotes, and tags

panel.filterPlaceholder: Filter loaded commits, or search all history
panel.emptyDescription: Your project's history shows up here. Make a change, then stage and commit it to record your first commit.

menu.rangeMergeReason: includes a merge — pick it on its own
menu.detachedRootHint: detached at the first commit — nothing to undo onto
menu.squashClearFilter: clear the filter — a squash range must be adjacent in history
menu.finishOperationInChanges: finish the operation in Changes first
menu.unarchiveBranchFirst: all other branches are archived — unarchive one first

createBranch.title: Create branch from commit
createBranch.description: Creates a branch starting at {{hash}} and switches to it.
createBranch.name: Branch name

dialogs.deleteTagDescription: Removes the tag from this repository. The commit it points at is not affected.
dialogs.deleteTagOrigin: Also delete the tag on origin
dialogs.resetDescription: Moves the current branch to {{hash}}. Changes from later commits stay in your working tree as uncommitted changes (mixed reset). Commits that were only on this branch will be orphaned.
dialogs.cherryPickManyDescription: Copies these {{count}} commits onto the chosen branch and switches to it. They stay on {{branch}} too. Commits already present are skipped; any failure rolls the whole batch back automatically.
dialogs.cherryPickOneDescription: Copies this commit onto the chosen branch and switches to it. It stays on {{branch}} too. If the destination already has it, it's skipped; a conflict pauses the cherry-pick on the destination branch, where you can resolve it and continue; any other failure rolls it back automatically.
dialogs.mergeParentDescription: A merge has more than one parent — choose which one counts as the mainline. Parent 1 is the usual choice.
dialogs.revertConflict: If it conflicts, the revert pauses in Changes for you to resolve.
dialogs.cherryPickConflict: If it conflicts, the pick pauses in Changes for you to resolve.

checkout.title: Check out {{kind}} {{name}}?
checkout.body: Your files move to that {{kind}} and HEAD detaches, so you won't be on a branch. Switching back to a branch returns everything to normal, and commits you make while detached need a new branch to keep them.

revert.title: Revert commit {{hash}}?
revert.body: Creates a new commit that undoes what {{hash}} changed, so history keeps both and nothing already recorded is rewritten.
revert.conflict: If it conflicts, the revert pauses in Changes for you to resolve.

cherryPick.title: Cherry-pick commit {{hash}}?
cherryPick.body: Copies {{hash}} onto {{branch}} as a new commit and leaves the original where it is.
cherryPick.conflict: If it conflicts, the pick pauses in Changes for you to resolve.

detail.pathNotInDiff: {{path}} is not in this commit's diff.
detail.selectFile: Select a file to see its changes
detail.notOnRemote: This commit isn't on {{remote}} yet — push it to comment.

blame.title: Blame: {{name}}
blame.errorAtRevision: Couldn't blame this file at {{rev}} — it may not exist at that revision, or the commit isn't available locally.
blame.error: Couldn't blame this file (it may be binary or untracked).

blamePicker.title: Blame a file
blamePicker.description: Pick a tracked file to see line-by-line blame for its current contents.
blamePicker.filterPlaceholder: Filter files — ↑↓ to move, Enter to blame

actionHints.reword: Keep the changes, edit the message
actionHints.edit: Stop to amend this commit's changes

editHistory.foldHeldHint: No older kept commit in this list to combine into

errors.foldWithoutTarget: The {{action}} action for "{{subject}}" has no older kept commit to combine into.
errors.keepOne: Keep at least one commit — you can't drop them all.
errors.generic: This history plan has an error.

editHistory.title: Edit history
editHistory.description: Reshape your unpushed commits — reword, squash, fixup, drop, or reorder. Newest on top; {{up}} and {{down}} move the focused commit. This rewrites local history; a conflict rolls it back.
editHistory.generateTitle: Generate this commit's message with AI
editHistory.editPauseHint: Pauses at each Edit so you can amend it, then Continue from the banner.
editHistory.rebasePaused: Rebase started — paused to edit a commit

emptyRange.patterns: These commits' changes all match your AI ignore patterns — nothing to describe.
emptyRange.unreadable: Nothing to describe — files whose names aren't readable text are always kept from AI.
emptyRange.both: Nothing to describe — files whose names aren't readable text are always kept from AI, and the rest of these commits' changes match your AI ignore patterns.
emptyRange.noCombinedChanges: These commits have no combined changes to describe.

rewrite.pendingGenerateReason: Wait for the squash to finish
rewrite.squashDescription: Combines the selected commits into one. This rewrites local history; a conflict rolls it back.
rewrite.generateTitle: Generate the commit message with AI
rewrite.noRunToGenerate: Nothing to generate from — this squash has no run of commits to combine

toast.detachedRoot: HEAD is detached at the repository's first commit — nothing to undo onto.
toast.cherryPickConflictNote: You're now on {{branch}} — resolve the conflicts there, then continue the cherry-pick.
toast.nothingToCherryPickOnto: Nothing to copy onto {{branch}} — those changes are already there.
toast.nothingToCherryPick: Nothing to cherry-pick — these changes are already on this branch.
toast.nothingToCherryPickShort: Nothing to cherry-pick — already on this branch.
